capability: Same-organization active-admin billing status and entitlement preview only.
advisor_assessment: All security and performance advisor counts are unchanged from the STORIS setup checkpoint. Existing findings remain documented; no new findings.
limits: No Stripe key read, provider request, customer/session/subscription creation, proration, charge, invoice, portal redirect or webhook change.
status/preview require strict activated verified mapped native identity plus active same-org admin. Public status/configuration probing and unverified JWT decoding were removed.

Preview uses active uncanceled recorded entitlements before tax; it is not a Stripe invoice or verified current charge. Negative prices and missing/unsupported currency return pricing_valid=false with no monthly total; bigint sums prevent 32-bit overflow.
create_checkout, create_portal and sync_subscription return HTTP 409 after tenant checks; configured and billing_enabled remain false.
Prepared admin UI previews recorded totals and disables automatic Stripe changes after entitlement edits. Canada endpoint calls are blocked.
Account/mode, destination webhook, approved prices/subscription adapter and idempotency verification remain pending; stripe-billing remains a pending complete-workflow dependency.
No hosted update, main merge, final source delta or source retirement.
